text:
maria.sec: FYI alert — backup-uploader serviceaccount (svc-backup-uploader-prod) did not emit audit log entries between 03:12-03:45 UTC during nightly snapshot upload. Cloudwatch alarm fired. Snapshots present and SSE-CMEK headers look normal, but no S3 PutObject DataEvents in CloudTrail for that window.

amanda.sre: looking into it now, oncall — grabbing the job logs and cloudtrail query

maria.sec: thanks. uploader SA is svc-backup-uploader-prod (IRSA). We switched to IRSA+STS last week.

jonathan.enginfra: i deployed the IRSA change 03:05 UTC yesterday to rotate away long-lived creds. deploy-bot shows rollout at 03:10.

deploy-bot: backup-uploader v2 -> prod rolled out at 2026-03-17T03:10:12Z :rocket:

amanda.sre: query i ran:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/svc-backup-uploader-role/
```
returns events before 03:12 and after 03:45 but gap in between.

sophie.eng-ml: KMS key used for SSE-CMEK is arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01. Key rotation happened 2 days ago, but decrypt calls show up in CloudTrail normally.

arjun.eng-security: triage items:
- check IRSA trust relationship and token refresh window (might have failed during rollout)
- verify CloudTrail DataEvents config (S3 data events can be filtered by prefix/bucket; we may have accidentally excluded the temp bucket)
- check IAM policy changes yesterday (who changed svc-backup-uploader-role)

lee.sre: running kubectl to inspect pod serviceAccount and env:
```
kubectl -n backup get pod -l app=backup-uploader -o yaml | yq '.spec.serviceAccountName'
kubectl -n backup logs <pod> | tail -n 200
```

amanda.sre: pod logs look normal, upload completed @03:18 UTC. No HTTP 4xx/5xx. I can replay a manual run to reproduce.

jonathan.enginfra: checking CloudTrail config — DataEvents for the prod-bucket were configured but with a prefix filter that excludes `/snapshots/temp/`. The uploader switched to `temp/` path on v2 for staging before commit.

maria.sec: that explains missing DataEvents (we only record the production prefix). But we also expect assume-role events — those are missing too for the window.

arjun.eng-security: could be STS token refresh race during rollout; if the pod assumed role but the OIDC token expired at rotation time, request flow might have used an ephemeral principal that CloudTrail didn't map to the role name in username field. Need to check CloudTrail raw event records and requestParameters.

amanda.sre: pulling raw events now, will share snippets.

backup-bot: nightly-backup job started 2026-03-17T03:02:08Z, completed 2026-03-17T03:18:34Z :white_check_mark:

amanda.sre: snippet (redacted):
```
"userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/svc-backup-uploader-role/session-xyz", "principalId": "AID...:session-xyz" }
```
present before/after gap; inside gap some events show `type: Unknown` with no principal mapping — suspicious.

jonathan.enginfra: i pushed one IRSA tweak yesterday that tightened the token annotation TTL. may have been too aggressive.

maria.sec: mitigation plan proposal:
1) re-enable DataEvents for the `temp/` prefix immediately (lee, can you update CT config?)
2) roll back the IRSA TTL tweak to previous value to avoid token expiry during rollout (jonathan)
3) re-run a manual upload to validate logs (lee/amanda)
4) open vuln/incident ticket to track root cause and next steps, include PM for change control

lee.sre: working on DataEvents patch now.

jonathan.enginfra: rolling back IRSA TTL in k8s annotations and re-deploying a canary.

amanda.sre: manual upload initiated, monitor for DataEvent entries

maria.sec: add follow-ups: create a dedicated audit-only role that can't write data but will always generate cloudtrail DataEvents and sts assume logs; add test harness that uploads to both `temp/` and `prod/` prefixes so we don't miss coverage.

sophie.eng-ml: also confirm KMS key grants — if we flip to a different encryption path during rotation it might change which principal appears in logs. not likely here but worth confirming.

arjun.eng-security: i'll start the incident doc and include the required triage checklist (RBAC diff, cloudtrail config diff, KMS grant audit, deploy timeline). assigning to maria for follow-up.

maria.sec: thanks. filing ticket now and will own the postmortem. tagging @oncall for any escalation.

jonathan.enginfra: can we add a short-term alert that triggers if any successful S3 PutObject to prod/tier has no corresponding CloudTrail DataEvent within 5m? would help catch gaps.

amanda.sre: yes we can, will add that alert after we validate DataEvents patch.

maria.sec: summary: root cause likely IRSA token/annotation TTL change combined with prefix filter on CloudTrail. Mitigations in flight; will post incident doc link when created. :thumbsup:
